author: Sol independent acceptance corpus author
isolation: Read only v5 runner interface code and frozen v6 candidate decision metadata. Never read v2-v5 fixture queries/results, calibration or selection actual data; no model/service invocation or retrieval trials. Corpus authored for natural source-supported questions, not candidate policy fitting.

definitions.positiveDefinition: Source explicitly states answer evidence, including reasonable paraphrase and translation.
definitions.noAnswerDefinition: Pure unrelated topics outside all corpus event records; no required-document mismatches.
definitions.unsupportedDefinition: Related event named, requested attribute absent; diagnostic only and excluded from OOD denominator.
definitions.evaluation: No model calls, trial retrieval, or post-result fitting by author.

review: Every positive manually checked against its primary source; forty distinct activities and relationships, bilingual paraphrases.
Near neighbors are separate activity types, stages, dates or objects and do not assert conflicting primary evidence.
All eighty OOD items concern general knowledge unrelated to fictional activity records; no relevant-ID mismatch denominator dilution.
Sixteen related missing-attribute questions separately label related source and missing field.
Exact structured IDs appear verbatim in designated source; keyword relevant IDs explicitly listed.
No prior fixture or model result consulted; frozen before any evaluation.
